name: shell.run
description: Run a shell command in an available shell backend. Returns stdout, stderr, and exit code. Supports working directory, timeout, and extra environment variables. This is the primary execution surface for botd-side work.

command.description: Command line to execute (passed to the backend shell).

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the invoking bot's home.

timeout_ms.description: Hard wall-clock timeout in milliseconds. Command is killed when exceeded.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the command. Must not override credential variables.

risk_rules: Argument inspection may escalate destructive shell forms (e.g. rm -rf outside the bot home, package/system modifications) to destructive at call time.

name: files.read
description: Read a text file. Returns the full content or a bounded window. Bots default to their own home; other paths require that the caller can reach them through the active backend.

offset.description: Byte offset to start reading from. Defaults to 0.

name: files.write
description: Create or overwrite a text file. Within the bot home this is a silent write (trace chip). Paths outside the home are subject to the write-risk escalation rules.

name: files.search
description: Search file names and contents under a directory. Returns matching paths with line numbers and a bounded excerpt. Read-only.

path.description: Directory to search under. Defaults to the bot home.

name: web.search
description: Search the web. Returns a ranked list of {title, url, snippet}. No content extraction — pair with web.extract when the body is needed.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: web.extract
description: Fetch a URL and extract readable text (Markdown-ish normalization of the main content). Optionally narrow extraction with a CSS selector.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to restrict extraction to one region of the page.

name: memory.update
description: Update the invoking bot's curated long-term memory files (soul.md, user.md, or memory.md). append adds a section; replace swaps old_content for content; delete removes old_content. This is the bot's only sanctioned way to edit its own identity and memory.

target.description: Which memory file: soul.md (identity) | user.md (about the human) | memory.md (long-term memory).

operation.description: append: add content; replace: swap old_content → content; delete: remove old_content.

content.description: New or appended content. Ignored for delete.

old_content.description: Exact existing text targeted by replace/delete. Must match uniquely.

name: memory.search
description: Search the invoking bot's memory files and session history. Returns matching excerpts with source file and context.

target.description: Where to search. Defaults to all memory files plus session history.

name: request_approval
description: Escalate an action to a human: push an approval card to the owning app, block the current turn until the verdict arrives, and return the verdict. For destructive or privileged operations that a risk_rule has escalated. The bot must state exactly what will happen and why.

action.description: Exact description of the pending action, tool id and arguments included.

rationale.description: Why this action is needed now; what has already been tried.

name: bus_publish
description: Publish an event to the multibot event bus. Phase 1: stub — events are logged to the invoking bot's trace stream only. Phase 2: full delivery to addressed bots' wakeup queues (cron_result, bot-to-bot messages).

payload.description: Event payload. Must be JSON-serializable and must not contain secret values.

name: list_inbox
description: List the invoking bot's pending wakeup queue entries (cron_result and bus events). Phase 1: stub — returns queue depth and oldest entry age; full entry listing lands with Phase 2 bus delivery.

bot.description: Bot name to inspect. Defaults to the invoking bot.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return, oldest first.
